theorems.statement: ∀ (P j m n' : ℕ) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) (h : n' = (j + 1) + m) (h₁ : n' + 1 = (j + 1) + (m + 1)) (h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (RY : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (flatD : Covector (Euclid P) (n' + 1) →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (flat : Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) m) (flatF : Fin (j + 1) → Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n') (r : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → RY.Represents Y → Y.boundary = X → 0 < r → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) (n' + 1)) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatD α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h₁)) → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → (∀ (a : Fin (j + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatF a α v = α (Fin.append (g ∘ a.succAbove) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂)) → ∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, currentEval Y (fun y => flatD (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (t + y))) ∂μHE[j + 1] = (∑ a : Fin (j + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a : ℕ) * ((∫ s in {s | s ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (g ∘ a.succAbove)) ∧ ∀ c, |inner ℝ (g (a.succAbove c)) s| ≤ r}, currentEval Y (fun y => flatF a ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (s + r • g a + y))) ∂μHE[j]) - ∫ s in {s | s ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (g ∘ a.succAbove)) ∧ ∀ c, |inner ℝ (g (a.succAbove c)) s| ≤ r}, currentEval Y (fun y => flatF a ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (s - r • g a + y))) ∂μHE[j])) + (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) * ∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, currentEval X (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (t + y))) ∂μHE[j + 1]
